title: Visa Intelligent Commerce link: token, passkey and instruction behind a TAP checkout
summary: What happens in VIC around a TAP purchase, using only the endpoint paths in Visa's own API client. The user enrolls a card with step-up verification and a passkey, approves a Payment Instruction with the passkey, the agent retrieves credentials for the purchase, presents them to the merchant in a TAP checkout, and reports the outcome as a confirmation.

steps.label: Ask the agent to add a card
steps.detail: The consumer links a Visa card to the agent.

steps.label: POST /vacp/v1/cards
steps.detail: The agent enrolls the card in VIC. VIC provisions an agent-specific token after step-up verification of the cardholder and passkey setup.

steps.label: POST /vacp/v1/instructions
steps.detail: The agent creates a purchase instruction. The user authenticates it with a passkey.

steps.label: Approve with a passkey
steps.detail: The consumer approves the Payment Instruction with a Visa Payment Passkey.

steps.label: POST /vacp/v1/instructions/{instructionId}/credentials
steps.detail: The agent retrieves payment credentials after VIC validates the request against the instruction.

steps.label: TAP checkout with the payment container
steps.detail: The agent signs the checkout with agent-payer-auth and carries the payment data in agenticPaymentContainer.

steps.label: POST /vacp/v1/instructions/{instructionId}/confirmations
steps.detail: The agent reports the transaction outcome to Visa; VIC signals support dispute resolution.
